## Key Courses

### Income Property Finance
**What I learned:** how to underwrite an income-producing property from start to finish. Our team built a full pro forma covering the rent roll and NOI schedule, unlevered and levered cash flows, depreciation and tax on sale, loan sizing with LTV, DSCR, and debt-yield tests, and sensitivity analysis to find a walk-away price.
**Tools:** Excel, CoStar
[See the project →](projects/retail-acquisition.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

### Automating Business Processes
**What I learned:** using Python to clean, combine, and analyze business data, including merging datasets, descriptive statistics, grouped analysis, correlation, and visualization.
**Tools:** Python, pandas, NumPy, matplotlib, Jupyter
[See the project →](projects/guide-pricing-analysis.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

### Data Visualization & Intro to Machine Learning
**What I learned:** designing visualizations that communicate a clear message, and the foundations of machine learning.
**Tools:** Python, Quarto, Git & GitHub. This website is one of the course projects.

### Introduction to Python
**What I learned:** Python fundamentals for working with data.
**Tools:** Python

### Semester in Prague
**International Finance, International Management, and International Marketing**, plus **Intensive Czech**. These courses showed me how business, markets, and management change across borders.
